title: cotoneaster buxifolius var. lanatus
intro: Cotoneaster buxifolius var. lanatus, commonly known as the woolly-leaved cotoneaster, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of China and the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, making it effective in soothing digestive issues and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster buxifolius var. lanatus include anti-bacterial, anti-viral, and anti-fungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential uses in modern medicine.
